title: Same salary. Three different futures
hook: Three people. Same job. Same salary. Watch where it goes.
caption:
Same salary. Three different futures. The one who looks richest is often the one who's one bad month from zero. We simulated {n_paths} careers for {years} years: spend everything, save {save_m}, save {save_b}. When the paycheck stopped, the first had nothing to stand on. The third could live {months_b} months on what nobody ever saw.

(Simulation: {ret} real return, {vol} volatility, median outcome, no taxes or fees. An illustration of a mechanism, not a plan.)

claims.text: Mô phỏng 2.000 sự nghiệp cùng lương trong 10 năm: tiết kiệm 0%, 10%, 25%; số tháng sống được khi mất lương (trung vị)

scenes.say: Three people. Same salary. Watch where it goes.

scenes.show: The first spends all of it.
scenes.say: The first spends all of it. Phone, bag, a car on payments.
He looks the richest. That's the point.
The second saves {save_m}. Safe. Nobody's impressed.
The third saves {save_b}. Same old car. Nobody notices.
{years} years later, the paycheck stops. A layoff. One bad year.
The first can't last a month. The second, {months_m}. The third, {months_b} months.
scenes.note: Simulation: {n_paths} careers · {years} years · {ret} real return · {vol} volatility · median · no taxes or fees

scenes.say: Looking rich is loud. Being free is quiet.
The difference was never the income. It was who they paid to impress.

dark-story.takeaway: Looking rich is loud. Being free is quiet.
dark-story.about: Three people, same paycheck: spender, saver, builder; ten years later the paycheck stops and only savings hold them up.
